artifacts.notes: The PDF contains an ABBYY FineReader 9.0 OCR layer, but it is a restricted nonretained artifact and is not registered as indexable text. Boundary pages were inspected for Lumen gentium (pp. 5-71), its Notificationes and Nota explicativa praevia (pp. 72-75), Orientalium Ecclesiarum (pp. 76-89), the Decree's separate vacatio-legis Notificatio on p. 89, and Unitatis redintegratio (pp. 90-112); a new issue and the Acta Pauli PP. VI begin on p. 113. Exact bytes are identified but not retained.
artifacts.rights_basis: The Vatican portal Legal Notes, reviewed 2026-07-23 at https://www.vatican.va/content/vatican/en/legal-notes.html, limit portal content to personal and non-profit viewing and prohibit collection, reproduction, dissemination, or transfer without prior written authorization from the Dicastery for Communication. No repository redistribution permission was established.
